app.name: Volei VidIA
app.notConfiguredBody: Create a .env file from .env.example with your Supabase project URL and key, then restart the app.
app.serverHelp: Enter the URL and public key of the club’s Supabase project (in Supabase: “Connect” button or Project Settings → API Keys). You only need to do this once on this device.
app.serverBadUrl: The URL must start with https://
app.serverChangeConfirm: Change the server this app connects to?

common.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this? This cannot be undone.

auth.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.checkEmail: We sent you an email to confirm your account. Open the link and come back here.
auth.signOutPending: There are {{count}} changes that have not been sent to the server yet (no connection). If you sign out they will be lost, because the data stored on this device is deleted. Sign out anyway?

club.noClubs: You are not a member of any club yet. Create one, or ask your club administrator to invite you with this email.
club.name: Club name
club.deleteClub: Delete the club and all its data
club.deleteClubConfirm: Type the club name to confirm:
club.noClubsSuper: There are no clubs yet. Create one.
club.noClubsInvite: You are not part of any club yet. Ask your club (or platform) administrator to invite you with this email.
club.logoInvalid: The logo must be PNG, JPEG or WebP and at most 1 MB.

home.phaseNote: You can now create matches, keep the score and code every game action (serve, reception, set, attack, block, dig and free ball) with its rating, zones and trajectory. Video and statistics arrive in the next phases.

members.title: Club users
members.inviteHelp: The person must sign up with this email; they will be added to the club automatically when they sign in.
members.lastAdmin: You can't remove the club's only administrator.

teams.title: Teams
teams.name: Name
teams.genericHelp: Creates placeholder players with consecutive numbers, handy for opponents: Name1 Surname1 (number 1), Name2 Surname2 (number 2)… You can edit them later.
teams.inMatches: This team cannot be deleted because it has matches. If you no longer use it, edit it and mark it as archived, or delete its matches first.

players.title: Players
players.imageConsentHelp: Required to upload videos showing this player to YouTube. For minors, consent must come from their legal guardians.
players.privacyNote: For data protection only what statistics need is stored: no date of birth, contact details or photos.
players.numberTaken: That number is already taken in this team.
players.inMatches: This player cannot be deleted because they have played matches and their statistics depend on them. If they have left the team, remove them from the roster or untick “Active” on the team page.

matches.title: Matches
matches.empty: No matches yet. Create one to get started.
matches.sameTeam: Home and away teams must be different.
matches.needTeams: You need at least two teams (yours and an opponent). Create them under Teams.
matches.noRoster: This team has no roster. Add players from the team's page.
matches.rosterLocked: The match has started: numbers and liberos can no longer change, but you can still add players.
matches.noPlayersCalled: No players selected for this team.
matches.takeOverHelp: As an administrator, you become the coder for this match.
matches.needRoster: Before starting, check both teams’ match rosters.

live.liberoAutoOut: {{team}}: libero {{libero}} leaves and {{player}} returns (moving to the front row).

cmdHelp.error: home / away error (point to the other team)

live.noCandidates: No legal substitution is possible for this player.
live.noLiberoOptions: No libero replacement is possible right now.
live.liberoRules: The libero may only replace back-row players, cannot serve, and must be replaced by the player they replaced. They leave automatically when they would rotate to the front row.
live.lineupIncomplete: Fill in all six positions for each team.
live.lineupHelp: Enter who plays in each position at the start of set {{set}}, as on the score sheet.
live.tiebreakToss: In the deciding set, first serve is decided by a toss.
live.autoLiberoMiddles: Comes in when a middle has just served (middles: {{list}}).
live.autoLiberoNoMiddles: No selected player is a Middle blocker: set it in the roster.
live.rotateForwardHelp: Rotate the line-up as on a side-out (II→I)

engine.set_in_play: The set is still in play.
engine.duplicate_player: A number appears twice in the line-up.
engine.libero_in_lineup: The libero cannot be in the starting line-up.
engine.max_subs: All {{max}} substitutions for this set have been used.
engine.max_timeouts: All {{max}} time-outs for this set have been used.
engine.not_libero: {{player}} is not a libero this set.
engine.libero_front_row: The libero cannot replace a front-row player ({{player}}).
engine.libero_cannot_serve: The libero cannot enter at position I while their team is serving.
engine.libero_must_return_for_replaced: When the libero leaves, {{player}} must return.
engine.libero_on_court: A libero is already on court ({{player}}).
engine.sub_libero_replaced: {{player}} is off court for the libero: the libero must leave first.
engine.not_receiving_team: The reception must be by the receiving team.
engine.not_in_roster: {{player}} is not on this team’s match roster.

S.ok: OK: opponent cannot run a quick

legend.title: Code legend
legend.partTeam: Team: * home, a away (optional; see below how it is inferred)
legend.partPlayer: Shirt number (1 or 2 digits; may be omitted for serves)
legend.defaults: Several codes can be typed in a row separated by spaces, upper or lower case. If the team is omitted: the serve belongs to the serving team; the reception to the receiving team; after a serve or an attack (other than /), the action belongs to the other team; otherwise, to the team of the last action.
legend.autoPoint: These actions end the rally and add the point automatically.
legend.zonesHelp: Each half court is numbered from the point of view of the team playing on it. Turn on “Mark zones” to tap start and end on the court.
legend.ex1: positive serve by the player in position I
legend.ex3: set by 3 and winning quick attack by away 11, from zone 3 to 8
legend.ex4: serve error by home 12 (point for away)
legend.ex5: full rally: the block by away 2 wins the point
legend.doubleSigns: You can also type ++ instead of # and -- instead of = (they are saved as # and =).

code.pickPlayer: Tap a player on court (or choose Serve)
code.tapStart: Tap the start on the court

csv.helpAll: Each row is a player. The “team” column says which team they belong to; missing teams are created. You can use Excel and save as “CSV UTF-8”. You can also use an Excel file (.xlsx) directly: the first sheet is read.
csv.helpTeam: Each row is a player of {{team}}. You can use Excel and save as “CSV UTF-8”. You can also use an Excel file (.xlsx) directly: the first sheet is read.
csv.chooseFile: Choose a CSV or Excel file
csv.needTeamColumn: The file has no “team” column. To import it, open a team’s page and import the players there.
csv.newTeamsOwn: New teams belong to the club (otherwise they are created as opponents)
csv.updateRule: If a number already exists in the team, that player’s details are updated.
csv.result: Done: {{teams}} new teams, {{created}} new players and {{updated}} updated.

video.title: Video
video.help: With the video loaded, every action you code stores the video time. Local files are not uploaded: each device picks the file from its own disk.
video.badUrl: The YouTube link was not recognised.

err.youtube_api: Could not load the YouTube player. Check your connection.
err.file: This browser cannot play the file. Try an MP4 (H.264).

video.syncHelp: If you coded the match without video (e.g. live), move the video to the exact moment of one of the actions (it is now at {{time}}) and choose it from the list. The other actions are placed according to the time they were coded.
video.syncOnlyMissing: Only actions that have no time yet
video.goTo: Show this play in the video
video.setTime: Set the current video time on this action
video.autoPause: Pause the video while typing codes

clips.title: Filtered video
clips.none: No action with a video time matches the filters.
clips.needVideo: Load the match video to watch these plays.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.empty: No actions have been coded in this match yet.
stats.pointsHelp: Points: aces + attack kills + block points
stats.errorsHelp: Errors giving a point to the opponent (=, blocked attack, block fault)
stats.showClips: Show these plays in the video
stats.clickHelp: Click a number to watch the matching plays in the video.
stats.rotationHelp: P1–P6: setter position at the start of the rally. If no player has the Setter position, the player in position I is shown.
stats.zoneHelp_one: {{count}} action with a zone. Seen from the team playing in each half, net at the top.
stats.zoneHelp_other: {{count}} actions with a zone. Seen from the team playing in each half, net at the top.
stats.noOwnTeams: There are no club teams. Create one under Teams.
stats.noMatches: This team has no played matches with data yet.

dvw.importHelp: Choose a .dvw file. A new match is created with the teams, players and all actions. Players already on the roster with the same number are reused.
dvw.exportHelp: Download the match in DataVolley format (.dvw)

offline.offlineHelp: You can keep coding: changes are stored on this device and sent automatically when the connection returns. Do not sign out until everything has been sent.
offline.onlineHelp: Changes stored on this device are being sent to the cloud.
offline.failedHelp_one: {{count}} change could not be saved to the cloud (for example, because you can no longer code this match).
offline.failedHelp_other: {{count}} changes could not be saved to the cloud (for example, because you can no longer code this match).
offline.discardConfirm: These changes will be lost. Continue?
offline.cachedData: You are offline: showing the last copy stored on this device. What you code will be sent when the connection returns.

youtube.title: YouTube
youtube.settingsHelp: Account and playlist where match videos are uploaded. Uploading is done from the web version (browser).
youtube.howTo: How to get the client ID
youtube.step1: At console.cloud.google.com, create a project (with the club’s Google account).
youtube.step2: In “APIs & Services → Library”, enable “YouTube Data API v3”.
youtube.step3: In “OAuth consent screen”, set it up (external) and add the club account as a test user.
youtube.step4: In “Credentials”, create an “OAuth client ID” of type “Web application” and add this authorised origin: {{origin}}
youtube.step5: Copy the client ID (ending in .apps.googleusercontent.com) and paste it here.
youtube.uploadHelp: Upload this file to the club’s YouTube channel
youtube.notConfigured: YouTube must first be set up in the club Settings (an administrator can do it).
youtube.webOnly: YouTube uploads must be done from the web version, in a browser: Google does not allow signing in from the installed app.
youtube.minorsBlocked: The video cannot be uploaded: these minor players do not have image consent ticked. Check each player’s record.
youtube.adultsWarning: These players do not have image consent ticked: {{list}}.
youtube.adultsAck: I confirm we have their consent to publish the video
youtube.rivalNote: Consent for the opposing team’s players is the responsibility of the club publishing the video.
youtube.keepOpen: Keep this page open until it finishes. If the connection drops, the upload resumes automatically.
youtube.done: Video uploaded. The match now has the YouTube link and the whole club can watch it.
youtube.privateNote: If the Google project is not verified yet, YouTube keeps uploaded videos private. You can change visibility in YouTube Studio.
youtube.playlistFailed: The video was uploaded but could not be added to the playlist: {{message}}
youtube.failed: The video could not be uploaded: {{message}}

report.generalHelp: Click&Scout format: count of each grade, #% (perfect) and *E% (efficiency using the Click&Scout formulas).
report.legend: BP Break point (points on own serve) · W-L Won-lost · Err Errors · Bk Blocked attacks · Pos% Positive reception (# +) · Exc% Perfect reception (#) · Op.Er. Opponent errors
report.empty: No serve, reception, attack or block data.

matchInfo.title: Match details
matchInfo.coachesHint: Each team’s coach and assistant are set on the team page.

admin.title: Administration
admin.deleteClubConfirm: All the club data (teams, players, matches…) will be deleted. Type the club name to confirm: {{name}}
admin.clubAdminHelp: If already registered, they are added as administrator; otherwise they get an invitation and join when they sign up.
admin.joinAsAdmin: Also add me as club administrator
admin.usersHelp: Superadmins see and manage every club without being members. A superadmin can also be a member (e.g. administrator) of a club.
admin.removeSelfSuper: You will remove your own superadmin profile. Continue?
admin.lastSuper: There must be at least one superadmin.

audit.title: Activity log
audit.help: Creation, changes and deletion of clubs, users, teams, players and matches; sign-ins, exports, imports and uploads. Kept for 3 months. Click a row to see the details.
audit.purgeHelp: Delete entries older than 3 months now (also done automatically).

radar.title: Performance chart
radar.help: Each axis goes from 0 (centre) to 100 (edge) using the scale in the table; further from the centre is better. Block: points per set.
radar.pdfNote: Scale of each axis (0 at the centre, 100 at the edge); values outside the scale are drawn at the end.
